name: ARYAN SHAH
bio:
Career Overview: Playing Style: A dynamic player with a solid all-court game, featuring a reliable serve and strong baseline consistency.
Career-High ATP Singles Ranking: #569 (December 2, 2024), Career-High ATP Doubles Ranking: #665 (December 23, 2024).
Best Grand Slam Singles Performance: Yet to play in a senior Grand Slam main draw; reached the first round of Wimbledon Juniors (2023).
Notable Achievements: ITF Titles: Won 2 ITF Futures singles titles (2024 M15 Kingston, 2025 M15 Ahmedabad) and 1 doubles title (2024 M15 Kingston). Biggest Singles Win: Defeated World No. 298 Siddharth Vishwakarma at the 2025 ITF M15 Ahmedabad QF. Junior Success: Achieved a career-high ITF Junior Ranking of #39 (2023) and competed in all four Junior Grand Slams. Davis Cup & National Representation: Represented India in the 2024 Davis Cup tie against Sweden as a reserve player.
Other Highlights: Transitioned to the senior circuit in 2024, reaching two ITF finals in Kingston (one title, one runner-up). Teamed up with Leo Borg (son of Bjorn Borg) in a 2024 ITF doubles event in Jamaica. Aims to crack the Top 200 in 2025.
Aryan is a promising talent in Indian tennis, blending junior pedigree with growing pro success. 🎾🇮🇳
